interpretations: For each funding source appearing among projects with at least one matching QC record, including a separate group for missing funding sources, count distinct projects with QC records; divide each count by the sum of those counts across all groups and by the average count per group, without rounding.
Include every funding source appearing in `projects`, including sources with no matching QC records; count those sources as zero when calculating the average per funding source.
queries:
WITH funding_counts AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source,
         COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanqc AS q ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
)
SELECT funding_source,
       project_count,
       1.0 * project_count / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share_of_total,
       1.0 * project_count / AVG(project_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average
FROM funding_counts

SELECT p.fundflux,
       AVG(COALESCE(q.qc_count, 0)) AS avg_qc_records
FROM projects AS p
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
    FROM scanqc
    GROUP BY arcref
) AS q ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry
GROUP BY p.fundflux
